heading: Crafting digital experiences with precision.
paragraphs: I'm a frontend developer focused on building modern web and mobile applications that are fast, accessible, and thoughtfully designed. I primarily work with Next.js, React, React Native, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS to create responsive interfaces and smooth user experiences across platforms. Beyond the interface, I also have experience with Node.js and PostgreSQL, valuing clean architecture, performance, and maintainable code.
